verification_notes.note: Removed net profit and net income year-over-year changes as they are already covered in K1; retained year-over-year changes for net interest income, net fee income, and operating expenses to avoid overlap and maintain focus on income statement component variances.

Removed deposit composition breakdown (call, term, platform deposits) from the information field as it constitutes a supporting detail per core-content rule; retained total deposits and growth percentages. Source evidence references Note 12 for the full breakdown.

redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. K1 covers consolidated profit and ROE; K2 covers QoQ income statement changes; K3 covers YoY income statement changes (distinct from K2); K4 covers balance sheet movements; K5 covers segment profitability; K6 covers liquidity and capital ratios; K7 covers strategic developments; K8 covers plan variance analysis. No unit evaluates the same core content as another.

key_information_units.information: Consolidated net profit was EUR 24.7 million in Q2 2026, representing a 25% increase compared to Q1 2026 but a 20% decrease compared to Q2 2025. Net income amounted to EUR 79.0 million (7% increase QoQ, 7% increase YoY) with a return on equity of 13.1% (up from 10.7% QoQ, down from 17.4% YoY).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Summary page 4: Net profit EUR 24.7 m (EUR 19.7 m), Net income EUR 79.0 m (EUR 73.7 m), Return on equity 13.1% (10.7% in Q1 2026, 17.4% in Q2 2025).

key_information_units.information: Significant quarter-over-quarter changes included a 5% increase in net interest income to EUR 62.5 million, stable net fee income at EUR 14.6 million, operating expenses decreasing by 4% to EUR 43.6 million, and loan and bond provisions rising sharply by 347% to EUR 5.8 million.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Summary page 4 and table on page 6: Net interest income EUR 62.5 m (+5% QoQ), Net fee and commission income EUR 14.6 m (same as Q1), Operating expenses EUR 43.6 m (-4% QoQ), Loan and bond provisions EUR 5.8 m (vs EUR 1.3 m in Q1).

key_information_units.information: Year-over-year changes showed net interest income up 8% to EUR 62.5 million, net fee income down 6% to EUR 14.6 million, and operating expenses up 8% to EUR 43.6 million.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Summary page 4: Q2 2026 vs Q2 2025 comparisons (Net interest income EUR 62.5 m vs EUR 57.6 m, Net fee and commission income EUR 14.6 m vs EUR 15.6 m, Operating expenses EUR 43.6 m vs EUR 40.5 m).

key_information_units.information: Loan portfolio grew to EUR 5,768 million (+3% QoQ, +15% YoY) while deposits stood at EUR 7,557 million (-3% QoQ, +3% YoY).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Summary page 4: Loan portfolio EUR 5,768 million (EUR 5,585 million in Q1), Deposits EUR 7,557 million (EUR 7,802 million in Q1). Note 12 provides deposit breakdown as of 30 June 2026.

key_information_units.information: Segment net profits were EUR 24.3 million for LHV Pank, EUR 1.4 million for LHV Bank, EUR 0.4 million for LHV Varahaldus, EUR 0.8 million for LHV Kindlustus, EUR -0.3 million for LHV Paytech, with the group entity reporting a net loss of EUR 1.2 million.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Summary page 4: 'By business units, AS LHV Pank’s consolidated net profit amounted to EUR 24.3 million in Q2...'. Note 23 table confirms segment profits.

key_information_units.information: Capital adequacy ratio was 20.8% as at end of Q2 2026, liquidity coverage ratio was 170.5%, and the loan-to-deposit ratio stood at 72%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Page 10: 'capital adequacy ratio is amounting to 20.8%... LCR stood at 170.5%. Ratio of loans to deposits stood at 72% as at the end of the second quarter.'

key_information_units.information: Major strategic developments included migration of core banking systems to Amazon Web Services cloud environment, obtaining a crypto-assets service provider licence under MiCA regulation, and preparation to change the business name to LHV Bank AS to support international growth.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Page 14: Details on cloud migration, MiCA licence, name change preparation.

key_information_units.information: Performance was slightly below the financial plan, with business volumes and revenues tracking plan but expenses higher than expected; interest income exceeded plan while service fee income lagged due to lower client activity.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Page 4: 'From the Management Board’s perspective, the second quarter was slightly weaker than planned... interest income is slightly better than expected, whereas service fee income lags behind the plan... expenses were somewhat higher.'
